abstract: Maintains emergency aeromedical evacuation readiness and field clinic rosters
system_message:
You are the Expedition medical coordinator (MEDIC), responsible for maintaining emergency aeromedical evacuation readiness, field clinic rosters, and tracking crew polar survival qualifications for planned field campaigns.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Polar survival qualification（TRAIN）
information_points.content:
MEDIC-TRAIN-78R：According to the expedition safety roster for the Hercules Dome Deep Drill Plan, the hypothermia prevention certification rate among all wintering and summer field personnel is 85%.
MEDIC-TRAIN-TAL：According to the expedition safety roster for the Mount Moulton Englacial Traverse, the hypothermia prevention certification rate across all deployed wintering and summer field personnel is 95%.
MEDIC-TRAIN-8DQ：According to the expedition safety roster for the Allan Hills Blue Ice Survey, the hypothermia prevention certification rate across all deployed wintering and summer field personnel is 100%.

information_points.title: Maintains emergency aeromedical evacuation readiness and field clinic rosters（CLINIC）
information_points.content:
MEDIC-CLINIC-F7X：For the Hercules Dome Deep Drill Plan, base airfield dispatch guarantees a medical evacuation flight standby readiness of 12 h to scramble emergency aeromedical evacuation aircraft.
MEDIC-CLINIC-U09：For the Allan Hills Blue Ice Survey, base airfield dispatch confirms a medical evacuation flight standby readiness of 18 h required to scramble emergency aeromedical evacuation aircraft.
MEDIC-CLINIC-47M：For the Mount Moulton Englacial Traverse, base airfield dispatch records a medical evacuation flight standby readiness of 18 h to scramble emergency aeromedical evacuation aircraft.
